data.name: Mahaali
data.gender_notes: Mahaali is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who resides in a place or lives in comfort and peace. In Islamic history, Mahaali refers to a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who showed great hospitality and generosity to the Muslim community. The name also symbolizes a deep sense of belonging and attachment to one's faith and community. The name Mahaali carries the meaning “Dweller, Resident” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahaali usually hope their child will grow to embody dweller, resident and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mahaali belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dweller, Resident.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahaali total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مھالي مشتق من الجذر العربي (م-هـ-ل) و يعني الارتفاع في الشأن و المكانة، و يوحي بالعظمة و الرفعة في الدنيا و الآخرة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و العلو

in_urdu.name: مہالی
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام بلند شان و معنی والا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہالی نام عربی جڑ (م-هـ-ل) سے نکلا ہے اور بلند مقام و شان کے معنی رکھتا ہے، یہ نام دنیا و آخرت میں عظمت و رفعت کی یاد دلاتا ہے، اور رفعت و علو کے معانیを持つناموں میں سے ایک ہے

in_hindi.name: महाली

in_hindi.long_meaning: महाली नाम अरबी मूल (म-हـ-ल) से निकला है और उच्च स्थान और गरिमा के अर्थ रखता है, यह नाम दुनिया और आगे के जीवन में महानता और ऊंचाई की याद दिलाता है, और ऊंचाई और उत्कृष्टता के अर्थ वाले नामों में से एक है
